description: Being Prepared for Climate Change: Checklists of Potential Climate Change Risks is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by publisher not stated on the toolkit page. Checklists help environmental professionals think about how climate change might affect their organization or place. Checklist items include potential risks that could be inferred from climate change stressors. The U.S. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
